reviews.comment: Dr. Tomberlin is really great. Not only are his lectures hilarious, but also very realistic and applicable to real life. I enjoyed taking this class. Attendance isn't mandatory, but you won't know what is on the exam if you don't go. Go to class-they're fun anyway! He also had really great TAs that often taught. Highly recommend this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This was hands down the best class I've ever taken at A&M. Tomberlin is hilarious and makes the lectures enjoyable. You don't have to go to class to pass, but I enjoyed going so much I went anyway.

This was his first year teaching this course. Dr. Coats is the usual professor. He was absent a lot, so the TA did most of it. He is very funny and makes great jokes. There are no tests which is awesome! You are graded of off projects and quizzes which are doable. Take this for an easy science credit!!
